name: 一部の写真へのアクセスを案内する帯
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
One Lighthouse component LH01-0070 一部の写真へのアクセスを案内する帯. Input1 original crop controls compact horizontal explanation + right Manage button structure. Input2 Japanese mock supplies exact Japanese copy, but its broad mint fill must be replaced with purewhite.
Draw a compact wide white#FFFFFF permission information band. Left copy verbatim "表示されていない写真があります。写真を追加すると、ここから選べます。" in Meiryo REGULAR40014/24-equivalent, tracking0, dark#1D1D1D; clean readable two-line wrap. Right white rounded rectangular button with thin neutral outline and green#1F6444 REGULAR40014/24 label "管理". Source Manage button is secondary; no large filled green area. Button centered vertically, ample horizontal padding and clear gap after explanatory text, no clipping. Thin neutral bottom divider permitted. All body/button copy same regular optical weight; no bold. Preserve source simple hierarchy and modest corner radius.
No icons, heading, photos, extra copy, phone frame or surrounding components. No broad mint/gray card fill, rainbow colors or dramatic shadows. High-resolution flat frontal isolated horizontal component, modest white margins. Permission settings/action behavior unverified; static raster candidate only.
reviewNotes: Correct Japanese copy, white surface and outlined management action; action label rendered visibly bold rather than Regular and excess external vertical whitespace. Needs narrow typography/compactness correction; raster only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
